end.summary:
- Court structure and appeal were practised: district courts, High Courts, then the Supreme Court.
- Vihaan answered easy structure and appeal questions correctly; a why or new-situation check is still needed.
- Free legal aid, Lok Adalat and PIL were practised; these ideas are still building.
- Vihaan continued to say that people without money cannot reach justice; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the court hierarchy and appeal using a referee example, and Vihaan answered the straightforward structure questions correctly. They also practised free legal aid, Lok Adalat and PIL, but Vihaan still mixed up access to justice with being able to pay a lawyer, so this needs revisiting. At home, use one simple example of a person receiving free legal aid and ask Vihaan to explain how that person can approach the court.

Aapka confusion paise ko lekar hai: lawyer ka kharcha mushkil ho sakta hai, par zarooratmand log muft kanooni madad maang sakte hain, aur Lok Adalat mein apna lawyer rakhna zaroori nahi. Agar kirayedaar lawyer ki fees nahi de sakta, toh woh kis madad ke baare mein pooch sakta hai?
Muft kanooni madad? Wo kya hota hai? Gareeb log toh court nahi ja sakte na, unke paas paise nahi hote. Lawyer ki fees kaise denge?

Muft kanooni madad ka matlab hai ki zarooratmand vyakti ko lawyer ki madad bina fees diye mil sakti hai. Aap soch rahe hain ki fees nahi toh court ka raasta band; lekin is madad se fees na de paana court jaane se nahi rokta. Agar kisi kirayedaar ke paas lawyer ki fees na ho, toh woh kis tarah ki madad maang sakta hai?
Muft... matlab free? Par agar lawyer free mein nahi karega toh? Phir toh court ka darwaza band hi hai na. Gareeb log vaise bhi nahi ja sakte, itne bade bade courts, kaun sunega unki.

Haan, muft matlab aapko fees nahi deni padti. Aap soch rahe hain ki lawyer bina fees kaam nahi karega, toh raasta band hoga; lekin legal aid mein lawyer ko madad ke liye lagaya jaata hai, fees aapse nahi li jaati. Agar fees aap nahi de sakte, toh legal aid se kya maang sakte hain?

Lok Adalat matlab logon ki court... jahan dono paksh apas mein baat karke, jhagda jaldi suljha lete hain? Aur usmein court fees bhi nahi lagti? Samjhaute se faisla hota hai, aur wo final hota hai? Sahi hai?

Haan, sahi: Lok Adalat mein dono paksh sahmati se jhagda suljhate hain; court fee nahi lagti, aur samjhaute ka faisla final hota hai. Ab aapki fees wali chinta par ek naya case lete hain: agar mazdoor khud court na ja sakein, toh unki taraf se koi aur insaaf ki baat kaise utha sakta hai?

Pata nahi teacher... chitthi se court ka case kaise ban sakta hai? Gareeb mazdoor court nahi ja sakte, lawyer ke paise nahi hain unke paas. Yeh sab sirf ameer logon ke liye hai, chitthi likhne se kya hoga, Supreme Court thodi notice lega. Kya koi photo ya example dikhao, kuch?

Aap keh rahe hain ki fees nahi toh Supreme Court chitthi nahi sunega. Photo abhi nahi dikha sakti, par board par raasta dikhati hoon: bandhua mazdoor khud nahi pahunch paate, koi aur unki taraf se chitthi bhejta hai, aur Court use janahit yaachika, ya PIL, ke roop mein sun sakta hai. Is case mein mazdooron ko khud lawyer ki fees dekar court jaana zaroori hai kya?

Nahi... usko khud lawyer ke paise dekar court jaana hi padega na, nahi to case kaise banega? Chitthi likhne se kuch nahi hoga, Supreme Court notice nahi lega. Gareeb log vaise bhi nahi ja sakte, unke paas paise nahi hote.

Aapko lag raha hai ki mazdoor khud lawyer ki fees na dein toh case ban hi nahi sakta. Is khadaan wale maamle mein koi doosra vyakti unke liye Supreme Court ko chitthi bhej sakta hai; Court use PIL ke roop mein sun sakta hai, haalaanki har chitthi case nahi banti. Agar mazdoor khud nahi ja sakte, toh unki taraf se chitthi kaun bhej sakta hai?

PIL... par mujhe lagta hai woh bhi sirf bade logon ke liye hai. Chitthi se kya hoga, Supreme Court notice nahi lega, gareeb mazdooron ki kaun sunega? Unke paas paise nahi hain na, toh case kaise ban sakta hai? Yeh sab ameer logon ke liye hai.

Aapka sawaal hai: bina paison ke Court sunega kaise? Sochiye, khadaan mein bandhe mazdoor khud nahi pahunch sakte; unki taraf se koi aur chitthi bhej sakta hai, aur Supreme Court use PIL ke roop mein sun sakta hai. Har chitthi par case nahi banta, par lawyer ki fees na hona is raaste ko band nahi karta. Ismein Court tak mazdooron ki baat kaun pahunchata hai?
